Japa Government MEXT Research Scholarship Details

The MEXT Research Scholarship offers an excellent opportunity for international students to pursue postgraduate studies in Japan with comprehensive financial support.

Interested applicants are encouraged to apply before the deadline on May 10, 2024, following the outlined application process.

Japan Government MEXT Research Scholarship Benefits

The MEXT Scholarship 2027 offers comprehensive support covering

  • tuition fees,

  • living expenses,

    • Students receiving the preparatory education and non-regular students: 143,000 yen per month

    • Regular students enrolled in master’s or professional degree courses: 144,000 yen per month

    • Regular students enrolled in doctoral courses: 145,000 yen per month.

    • A supplemental regional allowance of 2,000 yen or 3,000 yen per month will be added to the monthly scholarship amount for the grantees studying or conducting research in specially designated regions.

  • travel costs to and from Japan.

Japan Government Scholarship Requirements

To be eligible for the postgraduate Japan Government Scholarship, applicants must satisfy the following conditions

  • Applicants must be of foreign nationality and in good health.

  • Applicant’s academic qualifications and age requirements:

    • Applicants for master’s degree must have obtained a bachelor’s degree and be no more than 35 years old;

    • Applicants for doctoral studies must have obtained a master’s degree and have certain academic qualifications level, and the age should not exceed 40 years old.

  • Applicants must demonstrate excellent academic performance.

  • Applicants must also meet the conditions specified by the institution and major you are applying for.

  • You must not also be receiving other types of scholarships from the Chinese government at the same time.

Required Documents for Japan Government MEXT Scholarship

While applying for the 2027 Japan Government MEXT Scholarships for Research Students, you will be required to submit the following documents;

  • Mark Sheet Form

  • Application Form (1 original)

  • Research Plan

  • Attested copy of degree (hope certificate) and transcripts from the last universities attended

  • Attested copy of certification of graduation or degree certificate of university attended (1 copy with original attestation)

  • Recommendation Letter from the president/dean or the academic advisor at the current or last university attended (1 original)

  • Abstract of theses (if applicable) (1 original)

  • Recommendation letter from the present employer (if applicable) (1 original)

How To Apply for Japan Government MEXT Research Scholarship

To apply for the Japan Government MEXT Research Scholarship, follow the instructions we have outlined below; 

  • Click on the button provided to visit the MEXT Scholarship page.

  • Select your country’s embassy from the List of Websites of Japanese Embassies, Consulates General.

  • Download the application form and attach all required documents.

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for tests and interviews.
